verification.consoleRuns: A PS Vita on 6 Nov 2026. The logging build of 1.3 crashed in Beach Bowl's eel cave 85 s after Mario got there: sceGxmCreateRenderTarget failed and the dump shows a null write in update_scissor_test. The logging build of this source in the same run: 3 min 15 s, 444 pooled objects replaced, at most 16 at a time, no failure. Deep Dark and a lap of Sea Slide's ring: the same limit reached, 276 and 214 objects replaced, no failure. Star Bit reach: Mario still and the pointer hidden, Star Bits 1 at Off and 37 at All; Select stepped the level in the pause menu and it was saved. This package's eboot.bin and param.sfo, the only two files that differ from 1.3, over the test build: first start 11.6 s without unpacking shaders, repeat start 11.7 s, 7 minutes in Beach Bowl with Mario by the eels and no crash dump. Saves and settings byte-identical afterwards
verification.notCovered: The race against Guppy itself in Sea Slide (a lap of its ring with warps instead); the 2x and 3x levels of Star Bit reach with a real pointer; Launch from the LiveArea; CBOC Vita Installer; a PSVshell profile on PDEV00001; a console without PSVshell installed; installing over 1.3 with VitaShell (the two changed files were copied through vitacompanion); opening the Settings menu while the game runs (it failed in a playtest, unsolved); leaving with the PS button; a failed read across a sleep
